title: Require Service Context Funnel
forbids: a module current-owner alias into root base, context, middleware, or dependency registry; vendor os outside base.ts; a middleware file without a documented named const authored from the elected base factory or SDK-owned required telemetry builder; any other middleware export; explicit type arguments, inline expressions, locally declared callbacks, or arbitrary helper imports at native .use attachments; middleware authoring from raw base or configured service/module branches; or a shadow Context declaration outside base.ts
why: Context flows from the configured Effect-oRPC base through completed named middleware values. When a service elects host projection, its separate native factory is seeded with the same complete initial context without exposing contract or router authority. Inferred attachment preserves additive oRPC semantics.
remediate: Seed initial context on the sole contract implementer. When host projection is needed, return one private os.$context<CompleteInitialContext>() author from createMiddleware(). Author module capability middleware with that factory, keep SDK-owned required observability and analytics builders distinct, document and export only completed named values, and import attachments from their matching middleware boundary before plain inferred .use(name). Root SDK baselines may come directly from base.ts. Remove explicit Context generics, context aliases, helper-sourced callbacks, and alternate middleware roots.
message: Service context must descend through one native implementer and named middleware composition.
